explication: Home Assistant’s website combines documentation and site content with interactive community tools, product-story pages, and browser enhancements. The user-facing workflow is to visit the site, read rendered documentation or use an interactive page, and receive the corresponding page or generated asset. The repository also contains an Astro migration path alongside Jekyll extensions. Edges are limited to relationships visible in the README or sampled source; other listed features are shown without inferred wiring.
